title: Pasta with zuchini noodles
ingredients: 4 zuchinis spiralized
Celery about 4 full sticks chopped finely
Onion small chopped finely or lots of onion powder
Fresh oregano, about a 1/4 to half cup chopped
Parsley about 2 TBSP
Garlic powder or fresh garlic about 2 tsp
Some fresh lemon
Couple cups sliced fresh mushrooms
Olive oil
1lb ground turkey
600-1000ml pasta sauce (marinara, no sugar added)
Throw in the mushrooms when celery and onion just softening
Throw in the turkey, let it start cooking
If fresh garlic let it get a bit of color
everything out put aside, keeping the liquid if any
Take out the zucchini and cook down the liquid in the pan
Put everything bacj in the pan
Throw in the sauce marinara, add the oregano
Squeeze of lemon if need more acidity
Can garnish with fresh basil
instructions: Sautee the celery and onion in a tbsp of olive oil
Fry to get a nice crust on the mushrooms, add a bit more oil if needed
Add the parsley and garlic powder or fresh garlic
Sautee the zucchini until it's slightly wilted, tender but still with a good bite. Don't let it get too soft
